name: Tiger Breath Fire Styxx | 1G

A great opportunity to try these highly regarded THCA infused pre-rolls! Tigers Breath- That’s not blood dripping out of the tigers mouth, its actually Strawberry and Watermelon juice! Slow burn. Better high.
